It clarifies veterinarian responsibility for all services performed by licensed paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill directly addresses the veterinary paraprofessional workforce by establishing registration requirements and oversight for veterinary professional associates (VPAs), including certificate registration through the Department of Business and Professional Regulation, public listing of registrants, and grounds for registration rescission. It also expands telehealth prescription authority, which affects how paraprofessionals can support veterinary services.

bills.title: Veterinary Medicine
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes the veterinary professional associate (VPA) as a new paraprofessional category, requiring DBPR registration and defining their scope of practice and limitations. It also modifies telehealth prescription regulations and creates enforcement mechanisms for registration suspension and rescission.

bills.title: Practice of Veterinary Medicine
bills.last_action: Died in Industries & Professional Activities Subcommittee
bills.summary_ai: This bill directly regulates veterinary technicians by establishing licensure requirements, continuing education standards, scope of practice parameters, and disciplinary procedures. It clarifies what tasks licensed veterinary technicians can perform, what veterinarians can delegate to them, and prohibits unlicensed individuals from using protected titles.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Authorizing Certain Foreign-educated Veterinarians To Practice Under A Temporary Permit And The Establishment Of A Veterinarian-client-patient Relationship Through The Use Of Telehealth For The Treatment Of Urgent Medical Conditions.
bills.summary_ai: This bill expands access to veterinary services by allowing foreign-educated veterinarians to practice under temporary permits and enabling telehealth for urgent veterinary care. While primarily focused on veterinarian licensure, it affects the paraprofessional workforce by potentially changing supervision and delegation requirements as telehealth practices expand.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning Credit Cards And Health And Veterinary Care Services.
bills.summary_ai: This bill restricts veterinary care providers from promoting medical credit cards, receiving compensation for doing so, and prohibits charging for services before delivery or ancillary products without separate consent. It establishes disclosure requirements and refund obligations for returned products, affecting how veterinary practices manage financial transactions and patient billing.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning State Law Protections For Health Care Providers And Patients Related To The Provision Of A Legally Protected Health Care Activity.
bills.summary_ai: This bill extends state law protections for health care providers and patients regarding legally protected health care activities. Depending on how 'health care provider' is defined in the full text, it could protect veterinary paraprofessionals performing authorized veterinary medical procedures from legal liability.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Sunset Pet Animal Care & Facilities Act
bills.summary_ai: This bill continues licensing requirements for pet animal care facilities under the Pet Animal Care and Facilities Act, which directly impacts where veterinary paraprofessionals work and the standards they must maintain in those facilities. The sunset review process may modify facility licensing standards that affect staffing requirements and scope of practice for paraprofessionals in pet care settings.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Access to Veterinary Care
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses access to veterinary care by streamlining veterinarian licensing through endorsement and clarifying prescription drug use by veterinarians. While primarily focused on veterinarians, it indirectly impacts the veterinary paraprofessional workforce by affecting the regulatory environment in which they work and potentially influencing drug handling protocols and supervision requirements.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: cat declawing.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 479, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends veterinary practice laws regarding cat declawing procedures. It directly impacts veterinary paraprofessionals by defining which procedures veterinarians can perform and delegate, potentially affecting what tasks technicians and other support staff may assist with or perform under supervision.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Criminal history information: background checks.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 313, Statutes of 2026.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends criminal history background check procedures across multiple California codes and professions. It likely affects veterinary paraprofessionals as it appears to modify background check requirements that may apply to healthcare and animal care workers seeking licensure or employment.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Antimicrobial resistance.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Res. Chapter 103, Statutes of 2026.
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses antimicrobial resistance, which is a critical public health and animal health issue. Veterinary paraprofessionals play a key role in implementing antimicrobial stewardship protocols, proper medication handling, and client education in clinical settings.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants: scope of practice.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 371, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill directly amends state law to define and regulate the scope of practice for registered veterinary technicians and veterinary assistants. It establishes what tasks and procedures these paraprofessionals are legally authorized to perform in veterinary settings.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 205, Statutes of 2026.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends California's veterinary medicine regulations by modifying multiple sections of the Business and Professions Code, including sections governing veterinary practice, licensing, and professional conduct. The amendments add new sections and repeal others, directly affecting the regulatory framework for veterinary professionals and paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinarians: veterinarian-client-patient relationship.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State. Chapter 589, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This bill amends veterinary medicine law regarding the veterinarian-client-patient relationship (VCPR), which is a foundational legal requirement that governs what services veterinarians can provide and what tasks they can legally delegate to paraprofessionals. Changes to VCPR requirements directly impact the scope of practice and delegation authority for veterinary technicians, technologists, nurses, and assistants.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine: California Veterinary Medical Board.
bills.last_action: Chaptered by Secretary of State - Chapter 195, Statutes of 2025.
bills.summary_ai: This California bill comprehensively amends veterinary medicine regulations under the Veterinary Medical Board, modifying multiple sections of the Business and Professions Code that govern veterinary practice, licensing, and professional standards. The amendments likely affect the scope of practice, licensure requirements, and regulatory oversight of veterinary professionals including paraprofessionals.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act For The Department Of Education - Division Of Higher Education Appropriation For The 2026-2027 Fiscal Year.
bills.last_action: Notification that SB58 is now Act 138
bills.summary_ai: This appropriations bill allocates funding to the Department of Education's Division of Higher Education for fiscal year 2026-2027, which may support educational programs that train veterinary paraprofessionals. Funding for higher education institutions can directly impact the availability and quality of veterinary technician, technologist, and nurse training programs.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary practices; ownership; oversight
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses ownership and oversight rules for veterinary practices, which directly impacts how veterinary paraprofessionals operate within their work environments. Ownership and oversight regulations can affect supervision requirements, scope of practice authority, and employment structures for paraprofessional staff.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Animal abuse; animal neglect; classification
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses the legal classification and prosecution of animal abuse and neglect, which are critical issues that veterinary paraprofessionals encounter in clinical practice. Veterinary technicians and assistants are often first responders to suspected abuse cases and must understand these legal definitions to properly document findings and report to appropriate authorities.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary technicians; education alternative; certifications
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses alternative pathways for veterinary technician education and certification, potentially expanding how individuals can qualify and become certified in veterinary technician roles. It directly impacts workforce entry requirements and credential recognition for paraprofessional veterinary positions.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary technicians; certification; education alternative
bills.last_action: House LARA Committee action: Held, voting: (0-0-0-0-0-0)
bills.summary_ai: This bill directly addresses veterinary technician certification and creates alternative pathways for education and credentialing. It expands access to the veterinary technician profession by allowing individuals to become certified through means other than traditional educational routes.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Statewide Spay & Neuter Program
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a statewide spay and neuter assistance program and fund, which will likely increase demand for surgical procedures performed by veterinary professionals. The program may create employment opportunities and increase workload for veterinary technicians and assistants who assist with these routine surgical procedures.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Professional Licensing; Temp Permits
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes temporary licensing permits for certain professions, which could enable veterinary paraprofessionals to practice under provisional credentials while completing full licensure requirements. Temporary permits are relevant to workforce development and may address shortages by allowing qualified individuals to work sooner.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Extnd Bds:midwive/nursing/vet Exam/parole
bills.last_action: EFFECTIVE DATE(S) OF LAW SEE CHAPTER
bills.summary_ai: This bill extends the termination date of the Board of Veterinary Examiners, which is the regulatory body responsible for licensing and overseeing veterinary professionals including paraprofessionals. The extension ensures continued regulatory oversight and examination authority for veterinary technicians, technologists, nurses, and other paraprofessional categories.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Professional Licensing; Temp Permits
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses temporary licensing permits for licensed professions, which could directly impact veterinary paraprofessionals who need to practice while awaiting full licensure or credential examination results. Temporary permits are often critical for workforce availability in veterinary clinics during staff transitions or emergencies.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Disaster Emergency Plan For Pets
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes a disaster emergency plan for pets and service animals in Alaska, directly involving veterinary technicians alongside veterinarians in emergency response coordination. The legislation impacts how veterinary paraprofessionals participate in state and local emergency planning and disaster response activities.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Emergency Med Svcs; Operational Canines
bills.summary_ai: This bill addresses emergency medical services for operational canines (working dogs) and modifies veterinary practice laws regarding emergency care provision, liability protections for veterinarians, and potentially the scope of practice for emergency responders treating animals. The legislation impacts veterinary professionals by defining their roles and legal responsibilities in emergency canine medical situations.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Health care; allied health professionals, training; tuition grants and loan forgiveness; Rural Allied Health Professional Workforce Expansion Act and Rural Clinical Training Partnership Fund created
bills.last_action: Pending House Ways and Means General Fund
bills.summary_ai: This bill establishes tuition grants and loan forgiveness programs for allied health professionals training in rural areas through the Rural Allied Health Professional Workforce Expansion Act. Veterinary paraprofessionals could potentially benefit from these financial support mechanisms designed to increase healthcare workforce capacity in underserved rural regions.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: Veterinary medicine; veterinarian-client-patient relationship further specified; scope of practice inside and outside veterinarian-client-patient relationship further defined
bills.summary_ai: This bill defines and clarifies the scope of practice for veterinarians both within and outside the veterinarian-client-patient relationship (VCPR), which directly impacts what tasks and responsibilities can be delegated to veterinary paraprofessionals. By further specifying veterinarian scope of practice and VCPR requirements, the bill establishes the regulatory framework that determines which duties veterinary technicians, assistants, nurses, and other paraprofessionals are authorized to perform.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)
